tools.name: CYCLOID_MEMBER_LIST
tools.description: List all members of the organization. Use this to look up a member's numeric `id` from their `username`. The `id` field is required to build member URLs: /organizations/<org>/members/<id>.

tools.name: CYCLOID_PROJECT_LIST
tools.description: List all projects in the organization.
